online_result: The official pages confirm the museum, its 1928 creation and a medals/decorations collection assembled from royal holdings, gifts and acquisitions. They provide no named object records, object pagination or catalogue download.

secondary_discovery.finding: An academic museum study names printed catalogues including 'Abdeen Palace Museums' and 'Selections of Abdeen Palace Museums'.

exclusion_note: Generic gallery photographs are not object-level evidence and were not used to create or illustrate award rows.
next_action: Locate the named printed catalogues through library or archive holdings and sweep their medal sections if accessible.
